_n_pairs_subset_unit: Legacy field name retained for compatibility; the value 2383 counts measurements, not unique host–guest pairs. The subset contains 2260 unique host–guest pairs.
factorization: host_id = pandas.factorize(host_smiles)[0]; guest_id = pandas.factorize(guest_smiles)[0]; order = first appearance in suprabench_bap_clean_cond.csv

random.note: leaky upper bound: 98% of test hosts seen in train (killgate). Reported as the random-split reference only.

double_cold.constructor: 12-seed; per seed s in range(12): rs=RandomState(s); held_hosts=rs.choice(unique_host_id, max(1,int(0.25*n_hosts)), replace=False); held_guests=rs.choice(unique_guest_id, max(1,int(0.25*n_guests)), replace=False)
double_cold.test_rule: host_id IN held_hosts AND guest_id IN held_guests
double_cold.train_rule: host_id NOT IN held_hosts AND guest_id NOT IN held_guests
double_cold.neither: rows with exactly one end held-out are in NEITHER train nor test
double_cold.validity_filter: drop seed if len(test)<25 OR n_unique(y[test])<2 OR len(train)<50
double_cold.unit: block (the 12 double-cold folds are the bootstrap/aggregation unit)
double_cold.note: legacy raw-identifier recipe = suprabench_baselines_modern.dcfolds (L268-277); equivalent on the frozen clean subset to the smoke1/sim_null recipe (the len(train)<50 guard never triggers here).

family_cold.constructor: leave-one-family-out over family in {cucurbituril, cyclodextrin, calixarene, pillararene, cavitand, cyclophane, crown_ether, other}
family_cold.family_assignment: regex on host_name (suprabench_marginal_killgate.fam, L28-37): cucurbit|cb[\d -> cucurbituril; cyclodext|[abgαβγ]-?cd -> cyclodextrin; calix -> calixarene; pillar -> pillararene; cavitand; cyclophane; crown -> crown_ether; else other
family_cold.test_rule: all rows of the held family
family_cold.underpowered_flag: NO_CONCLUSION_small if n_host(test)<5 OR n_pair(test)<80; legacy n_pair naming counts measurements (cavitand/pillararene/cyclophane/crown_ether)

host_level_R2_CI.method: resample unique hosts WITH replacement (host = resampling unit, NOT individual measurements); pooled R2 per resample; percentile [2.5, 97.5]

block_level_double_cold.method: per-block R2 over the 12 folds; block-bootstrap of mean(model - best_null) gain with 3000 resamples; percentile CI; Wilcoxon signed-rank on block-paired (model vs best_null)

bootstrap_and_ci.note: Bootstrap units are host, family, or double-cold block as specified; individual measurement rows are not resampled as independent units.
